hub.tagline: Place exactly one king in every row, column, and colored realm. Kings can't touch — not even diagonally.

all.title: One king per realm
all.desc: The grid is divided into colored REALMS. Every row, every column, and every realm must end up with exactly one king.

all.title: Kings can't touch
all.desc: No two kings may sit in adjacent cells — not sharing an edge, and not even diagonally. Give every king a little breathing room.

all.title: Mark cells you've ruled out
all.desc: Tap once to leave a small MARK on a cell you know can't hold a king. Tap again to place the crown. Tap a third time to clear it.

all.title: Placing a king marks the rest
all.desc: The instant you crown a cell, every cell that's now impossible — same row, column, realm, and anything touching — gets dotted for you automatically. Remove the king and those dots clear right back up.

game.legend: tap once = mark · tap again = crown ♚ · tap again = clear · unavailable cells mark themselves
game.hintFailToast: Every realm already has its king.
game.winSubtitle: Every realm is balanced — next court unlocked.
